ISSUE: Despite node-interleaved execution order, 30ms and 100ms still hit netem overlap
30ms got 56s (= 20ms level) because 20ms netem was still active on d39-h04
100ms got 40s (= baseline) because 80ms netem expired mid-migration on d39-h06

Root cause: 600s chaos duration + ~30s tc add delay = ~630s window. Need >630s between same-node runs. With 10 iterations averaging 5min each, interleaving 4 VMs on one node isn't feasible without explicit waits.
Lesson: For future runs, either (a) reduce CHAOS_DURATION to 300s, (b) use tc qdisc replace instead of add, or (c) add explicit wait-for-cleanup between same-node iterations
